Save the date for our next online training: Two Paradigms Walk into a Lab... with Max Liboiron, Monday, Dec.14 at 12pm ET.

What an amazing learning opportunity! Come learn with us about anti-colonial research methods and about making sure research collaborations are not extractive. Max is one of the best speakers we've seen in years! 

You can register here to attend over Zoom: https://us06web.zoom.us/.../register/HYJGwOSRTq6diSzIt8MAkw
